passives.name: Kai and Gerda
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If none of Glicys’s Servants are present, damage taken is reduced by [Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_34_02]. At the start of the turn, Freezes the leftmost enemy for [Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1] turn(s). If the leftmost enemy is dead or absent, this effect does not activate. While a Servant is alive, when Glicys is hit by a single-target attack, recovers [Buff_V_4076001_11_3] Weakness Gauge after being hit. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Earth enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them, and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
